evidenceRecords.title: Chargebee: Billing & Monetization for SaaS and AI Companies

facts.statement: The chargebee.com homepage identifies the offering and brand as Chargebee.
Chargebee markets recurring billing and monetization capabilities for SaaS, software, and AI companies.
Its product set includes billing automation, usage-based billing, price books, invoicing, subscription management, payments, CPQ, revenue recognition, receivables, and retention.
The website presents a business software platform sold to companies managing pricing, billing, payments, and recurring revenue.
Chargebee states that global payments coverage connects 40+ gateways, 50+ payment methods, 100+ currencies, and 150+ countries; this supports global product availability, not a headquarters claim.
Chargebee lists offices in North Bethesda, Salt Lake City, Amsterdam, Dublin, Chennai, and Bengaluru.
The India office addresses are in Chennai, Tamil Nadu and Bengaluru, Karnataka; these are office-presence facts and do not by themselves establish headquarters.
The hasura.io About page identifies PromptQL as built by the team at Hasura.
Hasura builds software for secure, fast access to organizational data for applications and AI.
The page identifies PromptQL, the Hasura GraphQL Engine, and the Hasura Data Delivery Network.
Hasura says its GraphQL Engine and Data Delivery Network run at scale in Fortune 100 enterprises and provide access to critical data.
The policy names the operator as Hasura, Inc. and covers hasura.io products and services, including Hasura Cloud/Data Delivery Network and support services.
The policy gives Hasura, Inc. a San Francisco, California 94105 contact address.
The policy says personal information may be stored in several countries including the United States and India; this is data-processing geography, not evidence of headquarters or an India office.

evidenceRecords.title: What makes Hasura the next big thing in Indian SaaS

facts.statement: SaaSBoomi describes Hasura in the context of a new breed of India SaaS companies building developer tools for global users.
The profile says Hasura helps developers make sense of big data and is building tools for software developers and programmers globally.

evidenceRecords.title: DrDroid — Build agents for what begins after you ship

facts.statement: The drdroid.io website presents the DrDroid product and brand.
DrDroid provides agents that automate post-deployment maintenance and operational toil.
The site describes agents for investigating production issues and automating maintenance workflows for platform and infrastructure work.
The product uses AI agents and integrations with engineering and observability systems.

evidenceRecords.title: DrDroid: AI Agents for Platform & Infrastructure teams

Y Combinator says DrDroid builds AI agents for platform and infrastructure teams to automate triage, debugging, and remediation during on-call work.
Y Combinator lists DrDroid's location as Bengaluru, India.
The schbang.com website identifies the organization as Schbang.
Schbang presents itself as a creative, media, and technology company serving brands.
Its public site presents an agency/services model.
The site describes capabilities spanning brand solutions, campaign planning, media, content, production, and technology solutions.
Schbang lists locations in Mumbai, Delhi, London, and Amsterdam, including street addresses in Mumbai, London, and Amsterdam.
The contact page says the company was proudly created in India; this is origin language, while the listed locations establish present office presence.

evidenceRecords.title: Social Beat — Digital Growth Partner to Leading Brands in India

facts.statement: The socialbeat.in homepage identifies the company as Social Beat.
Social Beat describes itself as a digital growth partner delivering digital services to brands.
The homepage lists SEO and content marketing among its services and describes technical SEO and content expertise.
The company operates as a digital marketing agency and services partner.
Social Beat says it has 300+ experts across four cities in India, calls itself a pan-India growth partner, and says it manages about 3% of India's digital spend.

evidenceRecords.title: Social Beat is now in Bangalore

facts.statement: Social Beat announced a Bangalore branch office and supplied a Bengaluru, Karnataka address.
The company described its services as website and app development, SEO, social media marketing, digital advertising, and influencer marketing.
The article says Social Beat served clients across real estate, finance, e-commerce, startups, retail, FMCG, and healthcare.

evidenceRecords.title: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Services to Win AI Search

facts.statement: The thatware.co service page identifies the provider as ThatWare.
ThatWare markets generative engine optimization services designed to improve visibility in AI search.
The page offers GEO, AEO, LLM optimization, AI-search visibility work, and related SEO services.
The page presents a client-services engagement rather than only a self-serve software tool.

evidenceRecords.title: About Us: Who We Are at ThatWare

facts.statement: ThatWare describes itself as a digital marketing agency focused on advanced SEO and data-driven strategies.
The company says it applies artificial intelligence and related advanced methods to digital marketing and SEO.
ThatWare lists an India address at ThatWare Tower in Bally, Howrah, as well as UK and Dubai addresses.
Its contact form enumerates GEO Marketing, AEO Marketing, LLM Optimisation, AI Based SEO, ChatGPT/OpenAI/Gemini/Perplexity/Claude optimization, and fully managed SEO.
The scalenut.com product page identifies the Scalenut brand and platform.
Scalenut sells an AI visibility and search/content optimization platform.
The product includes AI Visibility Tracking, competitive visibility analysis, GEO content creation and optimization, content audits, and monitoring of visibility trends.
The product is designed to track and improve brand presence across AI search surfaces.
Scalenut presents a platform for content planning, topic discovery, content briefs, AI-assisted writing, and SEO/marketing workflows.
The site presents a software platform with account access and product workflows.
The terms identify the website operator as M/s Scalenut Technologies Private Limited and describe scalenut.com as its platform.
The operator's registered office is listed in Sector 58, Gurugram, Haryana 122001, India.

Products include Answer Engine Insights, Prompt Volumes, Shopping, Agent Analytics, marketing agents, AEO reports, and AEO/SEO solutions.
The platform analyzes AI visibility and provides agents that generate AEO-optimized content such as FAQs.
The site presents a commercial software platform with login, pricing, integrations, and team solutions.
The privacy policy identifies Profound as responsible for processing personal information on tryprofound.com.
Profound gives a contact address at 5 Union Square West, 4th Floor, New York, NY 10003.

Product categories are online payments, in-store payments, prepaid, fintech infrastructure, and credit processing.
The site markets a commerce and fintech product stack to organizations.

It offers clinic, hospital, and multi-centre management software, profiles, and provider advertising.

It lists Practo Technologies Pvt. Ltd. in Bengaluru and branches in India, Singapore, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Brazil.

The site presents a global enterprise customer market.

Managed services span cloud migration, disaster recovery, backup, database, and infrastructure; security uses SOC, SOAR, and SIEM.

SAFE markets an AI-driven platform connecting business context, attack surface, controls, and threat intelligence.

TAC Security lists a Mumbai, Maharashtra office.

The appsecco.com site identifies Appsecco through its own assessment offering.
It provides human-led security testing across applications/APIs, cloud/IAM, Kubernetes, AI/MCP, and agents.
Outputs include findings, attack paths, remediation guidance, revalidation, and recurring change-focused testing.
It sells scoped fixed-quote assessments and recurring testing engagements.
It accepts requests for product-security testing, urgent incident help, and partnership/reseller discussions.
An Indian phone number and IST support hours establish an India operating contact, not headquarters.
